commit.message:
perf: drop geth RPC histograms and shrink the enode memtable (#7983)

* perf(rpc): stop retaining geth per-method RPC histograms

go-ethereum v1.16's RPC server registers a ~19KB ExpDecaySample histogram
for every method/outcome pair it serves, regardless of metrics.Enabled.
status-go never exports geth metrics, yet ~110 such histograms (~2.1MB)
stayed live on a logged-in Android client. Wrap geth's DefaultRegistry so
rpc/duration/<method>/<outcome> lookups get a shared no-op histogram.

Refs status-im/status-app#22659

* perf(waku): shrink the local node's leveldb memtable

enode.OpenDB("") opens goleveldb with default options, preallocating a 4MB
memtable that stays live for the waku node's lifetime. Lower goleveldb's
default write buffer to 64KiB; the node DB only keeps the local ENR seq and
discovery bookkeeping, and is the only goleveldb instance status-go opens.

Refs status-im/status-app#22659

* test: share the live-heap helper between the gethmetrics and enodedb tests

+// Package enodedb sizes go-ethereum's in-memory node database.
+//
+// enode.OpenDB("") opens goleveldb with default options, which preallocates a
+// 4MB memtable that stays live for the node's lifetime. The node database only
+// holds the local ENR sequence and discovery bookkeeping, so a small write
+// buffer is plenty. go-ethereum offers no option for this, and enode's
+// database is the only goleveldb instance status-go opens, so the package
+// default is lowered instead.
+package enodedb
+
+import "github.com/syndtr/goleveldb/leveldb/opt"
+
+const writeBuffer = 64 * opt.KiB
+
+func init() {
+	opt.DefaultWriteBuffer = writeBuffer
+}

+package enodedb
+
+import (
+	"net"
+	"runtime"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/suite"
+
+	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/crypto"
+	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/p2p/enode"
+	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/p2p/enr"
+
+	wakuenr "github.com/waku-org/go-waku/waku/v2/protocol/enr"
+
+	"github.com/status-im/status-go/internal/testutils/goheap"
+)
+
+type EnodeDBSuite struct {
+	suite.Suite
+}
+
+func TestEnodeDBSuite(t *testing.T) {
+	suite.Run(t, new(EnodeDBSuite))
+}
+
+func (s *EnodeDBSuite) TestLocalNodeDoesNotRetainDefaultWriteBuffer() {
+	defer func(rate int) { runtime.MemProfileRate = rate }(runtime.MemProfileRate)
+	runtime.MemProfileRate = 1
+
+	key, err := crypto.GenerateKey()
+	s.Require().NoError(err)
+	localNode, err := wakuenr.NewLocalnode(key)
+	s.Require().NoError(err)
+	defer localNode.Database().Close()
+
+	s.Require().Less(goheap.LiveBytesAllocatedBy("leveldb/memdb.New"), int64(1<<20))
+	runtime.KeepAlive(localNode)
+}
+
+func (s *EnodeDBSuite) TestLocalNodeDatabaseStoresNodes() {
+	key, err := crypto.GenerateKey()
+	s.Require().NoError(err)
+	localNode, err := wakuenr.NewLocalnode(key)
+	s.Require().NoError(err)
+	defer localNode.Database().Close()
+
+	db := localNode.Database()
+	for i := 0; i < 500; i++ {
+		peerKey, err := crypto.GenerateKey()
+		s.Require().NoError(err)
+		var record enr.Record
+		record.Set(enr.IP(net.IPv4(10, 0, byte(i>>8), byte(i))))
+		record.Set(enr.UDP(30303))
+		s.Require().NoError(enode.SignV4(&record, peerKey))
+		peer, err := enode.New(enode.ValidSchemes, &record)
+		s.Require().NoError(err)
+		s.Require().NoError(db.UpdateNode(peer))
+
+		stored := db.Node(peer.ID())
+		s.Require().NotNil(stored)
+		s.Require().Equal(peer.Seq(), stored.Seq())
+	}
+}

+package gethmetrics
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"runtime"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/suite"
+
+	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/metrics"
+	gethrpc "github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/rpc"
+
+	"github.com/status-im/status-go/internal/testutils/goheap"
+)
+
+type echoService struct{}
+
+func (echoService) Echo(s string) string { return s }
+func (echoService) Fail() error          { return errors.New("fail") }
+func (echoService) Ping() string         { return "pong" }
+
+type GethMetricsSuite struct {
+	suite.Suite
+}
+
+func TestGethMetricsSuite(t *testing.T) {
+	suite.Run(t, new(GethMetricsSuite))
+}
+
+func (s *GethMetricsSuite) TestRPCCallsDoNotRetainServeTimeHistograms() {
+	defer func(rate int) { runtime.MemProfileRate = rate }(runtime.MemProfileRate)
+	runtime.MemProfileRate = 1
+
+	server := gethrpc.NewServer()
+	s.Require().NoError(server.RegisterName("test", echoService{}))
+	client := gethrpc.DialInProc(server)
+	defer client.Close()
+	defer server.Stop()
+
+	var echoed, pong string
+	s.Require().NoError(client.Call(&echoed, "test_echo", "hi"))
+	s.Require().Equal("hi", echoed)
+	s.Require().NoError(client.Call(&pong, "test_ping"))
+	s.Require().Equal("pong", pong)
+	s.Require().EqualError(client.Call(nil, "test_fail"), "fail")
+
+	s.Require().Zero(goheap.LiveBytesAllocatedBy("rpc.updateServeTimeHistogram"))
+}
+
+func (s *GethMetricsSuite) TestOtherMetricsAreStillRegistered() {
+	counter := metrics.GetOrRegisterCounter("gethmetrics/test/counter", nil)
+	s.Require().Same(counter, metrics.GetOrRegisterCounter("gethmetrics/test/counter", nil))
+	s.Require().Same(counter, metrics.DefaultRegistry.Get("gethmetrics/test/counter"))
+}

+// Package goheap reports Go heap memory still held by allocations from a given
+// function, for tests that assert memory is not retained. Callers must set
+// runtime.MemProfileRate = 1 before the allocations they want to observe.
+package goheap
+
+import (
+	"runtime"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// LiveBytesAllocatedBy returns the in-use bytes of allocations whose stack
+// contains a function whose name ends with function.
+func LiveBytesAllocatedBy(function string) int64 {
+	runtime.GC()
+	runtime.GC()
+
+	n, _ := runtime.MemProfile(nil, false)
+	records := make([]runtime.MemProfileRecord, n+64)
+	n, _ = runtime.MemProfile(records, false)
+
+	var live int64
+	for _, r := range records[:n] {
+		frames := runtime.CallersFrames(r.Stack())
+		for {
+			f, more := frames.Next()
+			if strings.HasSuffix(f.Function, function) {
+				live += r.InUseBytes()
+				break
+			}
+			if !more {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return live
+}
